title.zh: Democrats to Push Broader Crypto Market Structure Bill After Sweeping US Midterms: Report
title.en: Democrats to Push Broader Crypto Market Structure Bill After Sweeping US Midterms: Report

current_state.zh: House Democrats are reportedly planning to expand Maxine Waters' Crypto Investor and Consumer Bill of Rights into a broader market structure bill that would grant the SEC more crypto oversight and reduce the CFTC's role, after sweeping the US midterms.
current_state.en: House Democrats are reportedly planning to expand Maxine Waters' Crypto Investor and Consumer Bill of Rights into a broader market structure bill that would grant the SEC more crypto oversight and reduce the CFTC's role, after sweeping the US midterms.
